steps.content: You have to admit that compared to simulated experiments, the Ring Research Institute's cutting-edge applications perform far better in the field than you'd expected.
And the demonstration of teleportation between multiple fissures is beyond anything you could have imagined. Honestly, you could almost call it magic.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: This covers our latest progress. Through Mania dimensional entanglement, transitions between superposition states can produce effects like energy conversion, matter transfer, and so on. They're all theoretically sound, all carrying enormous practical value.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Of course, implementing any of this relies heavily on BR-003's unique properties. Its Mania field possesses an inherently complex dimensional superposition. That's what lets us identify relatively stable time windows that provide the environment our experiments require.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Scaling these technologies beyond this facility and into broader applications will demand significantly more verification. Other teams have been assigned to pursue that. I'll be providing support as needed.
The displeasure on her face is unmistakable, and yet she sees her report through with quiet diligence. By all accounts, she's a project lead worthy of the title.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: All of these achievements were spearheaded by our Chief Scientist. Summer's departure dealt a devastating blow to the Institute. The project stalled for two full years before Lemma took up the burden, reconstructing the complex models from the notes her predecessor left behind, then carrying them through to computation and full verification.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: She was only fourteen at the time—a genius scientist, the pride of the Institute, and its undisputed heart.
Lemma rolls her eyes again.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Spare me the performance. You've never once asked about our progress.

You don't let these little interruptions distract you. Instead, you focus on absorbing the technical briefing. There's something else you need to confirm regarding the technology used to conceal BR-003.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So if the enemy were to solve for your eigenvalues first, wouldn't that expose BR-003 to them instead?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: We have interference and concealment countermeasures, as well as comprehensive protocols in place. We alter the eigenvalues in time to prevent decryption. Combined with our dimensional defenses, these measures bring the risk down to an acceptable level.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you've been taking hits on a regular basis. Think about it, how many attacks have there been since last August?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Our progress has fallen behind, yes. The war disrupted too much. The Black Ring was forcibly exposed, used as a deterrent, and that left lasting damage. We still haven't solved for enough stable switching dimensions to fully guarantee security.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: That said, the theory itself is sound. We're working to close the gap. Once we raise the accuracy rate by another 2.3%, it'll meet the threshold for reliability.
You draw a deep breath, barely keeping your irritation in check. These scientists are definitely brilliant, yet it is just as undeniable that they can be remarkably naive and obstinate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those "comprehensive safety protocols" you mentioned are nowhere near ready, are they? Isn't that why you're so on edge? You're well aware that this project is extremely critical, with all these resources and manpower at stake. At the same time, you know full well the enemy is making their move. The problem is, you aren't prepared.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...There's still time. It's not over yet. I'll do everything I can to make it work.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does this stubbornness come from the fact that EDGE can't bear to give up such a powerful catastrophe weapon? Does DisCity need it that badly to keep the world in check?
Silence falls over the room. Outside the window, dark crimson shadows slowly drift by.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...Even after all these years, no matter how EDGE has evolved since its founding, scientists have always been its core. What we pursue is truth. Our weapons are will and rationality. Our only enemies are catastrophe and the unknown. It's that simple.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Don't lump me in with people who have twisted agendas.
Isomer brings her hands together in a single, ringing clap, and the crisp sound severs the thread of your dispute.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: This is a lecture hall. Keep it professional. Save your philosophy and politics for somewhere else.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I'm done here. He's clearly not in the mood for testing today anyway. We'll save it for next time.
steps.female_content: ...I'm done here. She's clearly not in the mood for testing today anyway. We'll save it for next time.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I need to get back to my calculations. That'll be all from me.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I never said discussions aren't allowed.
Lemma barely takes a few steps before being called back. She turns around, visibly biting back the urge to argue any further.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Time is running short. If you can't set aside your differences and work together, how are you supposed to collaborate later when every conversation turns into an argument? Your testing schedule still needs to move faster.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Take this somewhere else. How about you find a room where you won't disturb anyone?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: For instance... the <color=#fb9259>common lounge</color>? Even if things get heated in there, no one will hear a thing from outside.

Lemma flinches as though something has stabbed her at the words "common lounge." Her whole body goes rigid in an instant. She wrenches her head toward Isomer, the motion stiff and unnatural, and after a long pause, she finally forces a few words through gritted teeth.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: No... Not that place! That place won't do.
Without any warning, Lemma's entire demeanor shifts. A strange, taut edge of unease creeps into her voice, the change so startling that it catches you off guard momentarily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is the... common lounge?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Just a small sitting room in the residential quarters. They like to gather there, to chat and discuss things. It also serves quite well for arguments. There's no need to keep up appearances in there.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I said no!
All at once, the blood drains from Lemma's face, and her gaze flickers away, refusing to settle.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Really? I thought you loved that room, much more so than you do the lecture hall? After all, you all do spend most of your time in there, no? You've made plenty of breakthroughs in that space as well.
With those words, she turns her gaze to you.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Schorl can escort Chief over. I have work to attend to, so you'll have to resolve this yourselves. I'll leave Lemma in your care, Chief. With you there, I have nothing to worry about.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Persuading someone and reaching an understanding doesn't always require arguing, now does it?
The ghost of a smile touches Isomer's lips.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...You're doing this on purpose!
Furious, Lemma spins around and pulls out her terminal to make a call. Her other hand clenches so tightly that her nails nearly dig into her palm.
Though the other end doesn't seem to be answering.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Tch... of all times...

steps.speaker: Warning
steps.content: Your call cannot be connected. Please leave a voice message.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Enya! Listen to me, they're on their way. Don't open the door. Don't let anyone in! Whatever you're doing, stop! Pack everything away! I'm coming right now!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Don't let them find out, you hear me?! Not under any circumstances!
Unfortunately, a certain ticking time bomb, who had been completely silent on the sidelines, has chosen this exact moment to go off.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ooh, yes! I've totally grasped the fundamentals of dimensional fissures now! This is so cool! For the first test run, how about we open one straight into the common lounge?
Lemma can't even get a word out before Summer snatches your wrist.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let's roll, Chief! Here we gooo!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Summer!! You—
With a sweep of her hand, Summer carves a gash in the air itself. A fissure tears open before her. Still holding fast to your wrist, she strides straight through.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Wohooo!
Summer's exhilarated cheer echoes through the rift, leaving Lemma's near-desperate cry of protest far behind.
Inside the fissure's passage, layers of light and shadow sweep past as security cameras and gates flash by like a feverish carousel.
Iris scanners, armed patrols, electromagnetic fences, blast-proof isolation doors... One would think this "lounge" is actually a secret fortress, with how it's sealed tighter than a vault.
It even outstrips the Bureau's highest-level security protocols. You can't help but wonder what exactly lies behind all these layers of lockdown.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Whatever you're doing, stop! Pack everything away!

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Don't let them find out, you hear me?! Not under any circumstances!
Undisclosed Ring Research Institute experiments? Dangerous samples? Forbidden research findings? Or something that even she doesn't dare let outsiders know about...
These grim thoughts race through your mind as you bypass the final barrier, slamming open the massive blast-proof door ahead—
[Idol Music Blasts] chu-lu-chu, pa-pa-pa!

In an instant, a pink melody drowns the corridor. Saccharine synth tones, skipping drumbeats, and lyrics that babble like some primordial language—unintelligible, yet maddeningly catchy—assault your eardrums from every direction.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: ♪~ Louder! Use your core! What, did none of you eat today?!

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Clap, clap, clap—hey!

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Da, da, da—huh?

Inside the lounge, Sarah enthusiastically waves a glowing light stick, bobbing to the rhythm. Barrie is slouched on the sofa, clapping along to the beat. Meanwhile, Enya stands by the blackboard, rigorously practicing some idol's signature choreography in front of a mirror.
Enya's hand freezes mid-air as she spots you and Summer in the doorway. The music pounds on, but everyone else goes completely rigid, as if someone hit the pause button for reality itself.
